## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the change (a bug fix includes a test that fails without it)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under **Unreleased**, if users or contributors would notice
- [ ] Docs updated if behaviour, the API or the architecture changed (`docs/`, `README.md`)
- [ ] The JSON contract changed in both `api/schemas.py` and `ui/src/types.ts`, if at all
- [ ] Anything guests of a hosting desktop app can reach is covered by a test (see `docs/architecture.md`, *Security boundaries*)
